'''June 2001 Jenkintown tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Brave New Worlds, Jenkintown, PA on 24 June 2001. [[Andy Talaga]] won it. It is known from Ted Panczyszyn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2510">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-24-jenkintown-pa-6-24-01d2510/ jenkintown-pa-6-24-01], DeckTech (Ted "Rogue15" Panczyszyn, 24 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-24-jenkintown-pa-6-24-01d2510/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Brave New Worlds, Jenkintown, PA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Andy Talaga]]
